title: Live baseline and compact context
scope: Snapshot current root hashes; export fresh ERC/DRC/parity/netlist and footprint/pad/stackup summaries without changing CAD. Inspect helper scripts before use; adapt stale wrappers in an isolated validation project.
inputs: Root native project; completion plan; latest layout review
deliverables: state.json; baseline reports; context.txt; file-index.csv
pass_criteria: Fresh reports identify their exact input hashes; root source unchanged; prior drafts not promoted.

title: Primary-source component evidence
scope: Extract exact selected-part limits and package drawings by component family. Record tables/pages/conditions and source hashes; do not choose substitutes or infer ratings from headlines.
inputs: 1.1 inventory; TI DDWR and selected Q1/regulator/connector/relay datasheets
deliverables: component-evidence.csv; source index
pass_criteria: Every numerical limit has units, conditions, exact MPN/package and primary-source location; missing data explicit.

title: As-built pin and connector maps
scope: Derive GPIO, expander addresses/bits, connector pins and schematic-to-PCB mappings using deterministic extraction. Include the proposed Z mapping separately from current hardware.
inputs: 1.1 exports; authoritative root schematics
deliverables: pinmap.csv; connector-map.csv; discrepancy list
pass_criteria: Maps reconcile fresh netlist and PCB pads; no invented or stale StepStick mappings.

title: Reset and inhibit behavior
scope: Audit cold/warm boot, power-domain sequencing, E-stop, watchdog, expander retained state, faults, missing jumpers and re-arm behavior; distinguish DC brake and high-Z states.
inputs: Relevant schematic slices; 1.2 selected-device evidence; 1.3 map
deliverables: truth-table.csv; timing targets; electrical issues
pass_criteria: Every defined fault has a reasoned output state and recovery sequence tied to actual pins and component behavior.

title: Power path and protection budget
scope: Calculate STEPPER_ONLY and COMBINED input/component currents, Q1 and regulator dissipation, fuse/connector/copper limits and bounded return-energy envelope. Include radio/peripheral loads and tolerances.
inputs: Relevant power/DC schematics; geometry extracts; 1.2 evidence
deliverables: power-budget.csv; protection-envelope.txt; reproducible calculations
pass_criteria: No battery/phase-current conflation; margins and unknown motor/BMS properties explicit; failed budget is an issue rather than a cooling assumption.

title: Driver and board thermal model
scope: Calculate 2/3/3.5 A RMS driver losses and thermal paths, shared heating, actual 1 oz baseline and candidate 2 oz/via options. Include PCB resistance between exposed pad and underside sink.
inputs: Selected DDWR data; 1.1 geometry; 1.5 loads; thermal construction evidence
deliverables: thermal-model script/results; heat map; sink/interface requirements
pass_criteria: Source-backed units and hot losses; sensitivity/uncertainty; both profiles; 40 C ambient and proposed <=125 C driver-junction target checked.

title: Independent electrical and thermal gate
scope: Challenge coupled assumptions in the circuit, load budget, fault behavior and thermal model. Recompute representative cases and inspect source evidence independently. No CAD edits.
inputs: Frozen phase-1 evidence pack plus selected original source/schematic excerpts
deliverables: phase-1-review.txt; approved decisions and issue owners
pass_criteria: No unresolved electrical/protection/thermal blocker; unmeasured claims and unresolved requirements remain explicit. Stop for user review.

title: Z-limit schematic and placement
scope: Add J607 and matching two 4.7k/two 1k/two 10nF network using U704.19/.20; move existing connector bank down nominally 10.5 mm and add top connector. Validate isolated draft against live source before reuse.
inputs: Accepted phase-1 pin map; local bank/OLED geometry; current root
deliverables: Root CAD delta; fresh netlist; placement views
pass_criteria: Existing pin functions retained; correct Z mappings; actual courtyard/edge/OLED/cable checks; only declared schematic changes.

title: Reconnect moved bank and Z inputs
scope: Route the moved connectors and new conditioning/network locally. Preserve existing input/output contracts, ground reference and power copper.
inputs: 2.1 local geometry/netlist; exact before snapshot; approved routing constraints
deliverables: Root routing delta; local connectivity report
pass_criteria: All new and moved-bank pad groups connected; no accidental pad/via net reassignment or unrelated lost groups.

title: U702 sleep-pin escape
scope: Close AX2_SLEEP_N using actual connected anchors. Preserve charge-pump loop; use bounded local R721/ENABLE-fanout adjustment only if needed.
inputs: Fresh target-net components; U702 local F/B/In2 plots; R721 candidate
deliverables: Route delta; DRC and before/after local view
pass_criteria: Target net closed without sacrificing power/thermal/charge-pump geometry; stopped searches report obstacle geometry.

title: Close CS and E-stop-feed gaps
scope: Route AX3_CS_N and +3V3_DRV_EN as two sequential net-specific substeps. Validate each before proceeding; the latter is the E-stop-derived logic feed.
inputs: Fresh connected-anchor reports and local corridors; phase-1 maps
deliverables: Two route deltas; current connectivity/DRC
pass_criteria: Both gaps closed; correct logical topology retained; no signal use of In1 ground layer or reserved heat-contact areas.

title: DVDD loops and signal cleanup
scope: Trial in-place capacitor flips and shorter supply/return loops; retire only proven orphan stubs and redundant signal geometry. Keep intentional current and thermal structures.
inputs: Local capacitor/return geometry; raw warning items; phase-1 thermal constraints
deliverables: Geometry delta; retained-connected-group audit
pass_criteria: Every retained change has an actual loop/routing benefit; no blanket deletion of dangling-warning items.

title: Silkscreen and connector legends
scope: Apply prescribed front/back reference/function/pin labels for the shifted bank and J607; resolve identified overlaps without altering copper.
inputs: Accepted connector map; actual footprint views; exact label issues
deliverables: Root label-only delta; front/back plots
pass_criteria: Correct physical pin positions on both faces; readable assembled labels; copper/net geometry unchanged.

title: Layout regression review
scope: Run fresh refill/ERC/DRC/parity and compare all old pad groups, allowed net changes, critical copper and new via-drill clearances. Review warning dispositions and actual layout.
inputs: Fresh root and before state; change manifest; official pin evidence
deliverables: Phase-2 audit; issue list; final native previews
pass_criteria: Zero opens and unexplained errors; no parity mismatch or unapproved topology/copper loss. Stop for user review.

title: Exact sourcing evidence
scope: Collect exact availability/drawings for selected MPNs, capacitor dimensions/ripple, harness contacts, relay holes, OLED stack, TIM and heatsink candidates. Report gaps; no substitution approval.
inputs: Approved MPN list; supplier sources; mechanical envelope
deliverables: sourcing.csv; numbered-pad/dimension evidence
pass_criteria: Every candidate exact variant and source/date recorded; no misleading stock equivalence or package assumptions.

title: Passive heatsink assembly
scope: Choose dimensioned common or individual underside cooling from the thermal budget. Specify TIM, insulation, support, flatness, compression and natural-convection conditions; check cable/solder-tail/antenna access.
inputs: 1.6 thermal model; current geometry; 3.1 parts evidence
deliverables: Cooling/assembly drawing; thermal-resistance allocation; exact parts
pass_criteria: Buildable fit with mechanical tolerances, no board bow or live-copper contact, thermal coupling accounted for.

title: Thermal copper and fabrication construction
scope: Implement only justified local GND/via/mask/paste or stackup changes. Validate fabricator limits for chosen copper and fine pitch; reconcile actual PowerPAD solder/via process.
inputs: 3.2 drawings; 1.6 calculations; exact fab/assembler process evidence
deliverables: Root thermal delta; mask/paste views; fabrication notes; repeated DRC/parity
pass_criteria: Quantified heat-path improvement; preserved intended return paths and nets; supported assembly process; no new routing regression.

title: Mechanical and procurement freeze
scope: Reconcile final mechanical stack, exact BOM, hand-fit/DNP decisions and all phase-3 CAD changes. Independently check relay pad mapping and post-thermal geometry.
inputs: 3.1-3.3 evidence; fresh native checks
deliverables: Phase-3 BOM/drawings/audit; closed exceptions
pass_criteria: No critical mechanical/part/process unknown; phases 2 and 3 remain electrically consistent. Stop for user review.

title: Firmware board definition and diagnostics skeleton
scope: Create explicit versioned GPIO/expander/connector definitions and buildable diagnostic scaffolding from approved maps; no guessed hardware allocation.
inputs: Approved 1.3 map; selected toolchain documents
deliverables: Firmware build; board definitions; map consistency check
pass_criteria: Build reproducible; definitions match source-reviewed pin map, including Z bits; no motor-arm logic enabled by scaffolding.

title: Arming, watchdog and latched faults
scope: Implement reviewed state machine, warm-reset handling, safe expander sequencing, verified configuration and progress-based watchdog; define safe stop/re-arm actions.
inputs: 1.4 state/timing specification; board definitions
deliverables: State-machine firmware; representative fault/sequence tests
pass_criteria: Behavior matches 1.4 truth table; failure cannot silently arm/restart; logical tests distinguished from physical measurements.

title: Hardware pulse generation and motion bounds
scope: Implement synchronized STEP/DIR timing with appropriate hardware peripherals; acceleration, buffer-underrun and bounded-command handling.
inputs: Selected ESP-IDF primary docs; timing contract; 4.2 API
deliverables: Motion module; timing tests; expected scope traces
pass_criteria: No I2C-generated pulse train; DIR/pulse timings respect device data; failure/underrun follows accepted inhibit policy.

title: Limits and onboard/external modes
scope: Implement all limit/encoder checks and controlled retreat; axis mode selection and external interface profiles; no armed mode change.
inputs: Approved connector map; 4.2-4.3 interfaces
deliverables: I/O/mode module; simulated limit/mode tests
pass_criteria: Existing DC/X/Y mapping retained; Z works logically; EXT remains ESP-controlled; mode transitions are defined and bounded.

title: Operating profiles, telemetry and calibration
scope: Implement STEPPER_ONLY/COMBINED ceilings, DC burst limits, readback, fault/OT reporting, timestamped logs and versioned calibration/configuration integrity.
inputs: Approved power/thermal ceilings; telemetry scale/error model
deliverables: Profile/diagnostic firmware; schema and decoder; calibration commands
pass_criteria: No unqualified setting enabled by default; DC commands locked off in stepper-only mode; measurements distinguish inferred/set/observed quantities.

title: Firmware integration gate
scope: Review reset/fault/timing/profile interactions against final hardware; run meaningful host tests and build checks; define unrun hardware tests.
inputs: Final board definition; source modules; independent requirements/test mapping
deliverables: Phase-4 review; build artifacts; test map
pass_criteria: Every safety/timing requirement mapped to a check; firmware ready for controlled commissioning. Stop for user review.

title: Reproducible first-article export
scope: Export matched CAM, BOM, CPL and assembly drawings from frozen native source with version/tool/hash manifest. Never rebuild CAD with legacy generators.
inputs: Frozen CAD; exact approved BOM; reviewed export commands
deliverables: First-article candidate bundle; manifest; deterministic exporter
pass_criteria: All outputs from same source revision; counts/references reconcile; originals/releases preserved.

title: CAM, numbered-pad and assembly audit
scope: Check actual Gerbers/mask/paste/drills, layer stack, clearances, populated sides, every MPN pin1/polarity and CPL origin/rotation against supplier drawings and assembly preview.
inputs: 5.1 outputs; exact source drawings; current assembly preview
deliverables: CAM/assembly audit with annotated evidence; dispositions
pass_criteria: No unexplained orientation/package/process discrepancy; 3D model is not sole placement proof; heatsink/harness/fuse details included.

title: Independent first-article release gate
scope: Read actual source/output checks and challenge electrical, thermal and assembly consistency. Confirm test firmware/fixture readiness and list post-fabrication tests explicitly.
inputs: Compact accepted phase evidence; selected original CAD/CAM/source checks
deliverables: Phase-5 first-article release recommendation; unresolved issues
pass_criteria: Pre-fabrication blockers closed; no claims of powered qualification. Stop for user review; no order/upload/push by review alone.

title: Bench fixture and commissioning procedure
scope: Prepare intended-voltage energy-limited fixture, probe references, calibrated instruments, rail targets, scope setup, thermal sensors and step-by-step stop conditions.
inputs: Released hardware/firmware; power/protection envelope; available instruments
deliverables: Fixture/procedure; expected observations; blank result sheets
pass_criteria: Energy-return path defined before regeneration; no unjustified destructive short/reverse/hot-plug procedure; all readings attributable to a test setup.

title: First power and interface evidence
scope: A human technician inspects assembly, powers at intended voltage and checks rails, USB/battery modes and all interfaces. Model reviews supplied measurements and photos.
inputs: Physical first article; technician readings and instruments; 6.1 procedure
deliverables: Actual bench records; assembly and rail measurements; interface results
pass_criteria: No unintended energization, cycling/backfeed or unexplained heat; failures investigated; missing physical evidence remains NOT RUN.

title: Fault timing and low-current motors
scope: Human measures reset/E-stop/watchdog/config-failure behavior and one low-current motor per channel; model compares scope/current records with timing/behavior contract.
inputs: 6.2 passed setup; measured scope/current data; fault truth table
deliverables: Fault/timing traces; low-current motor records; phase-6 report
pass_criteria: Each expected state/timing verified; no unexpected restart; escalation to Sol High for ambiguous waveforms or contradictions. Stop for user review.

title: Qualification experiment design
scope: Freeze matrix for current, all-axis concurrency, hold/motion, ambient, heatsink orientation, DC duty, cables and calibration uncertainty. Define stop/acceptance criteria before testing.
inputs: Approved targets; actual parts/fixture; commissioning evidence
deliverables: Qualification matrix; thermal/current uncertainty method; report templates
pass_criteria: Tests isolate assumptions and cover both profiles; 3.5 A port tests excluded unless complete path specifications allow them.

title: Per-axis and all-axis thermal runs
scope: Human performs progressive 2 A then allowed 3 A stepper-only tests, including hold and motion; model analyzes temperature/current/voltage trends and equilibrium.
inputs: 7.1 matrix; actual bench time-series and configuration
deliverables: Raw logs; plots; measured margins and exceptions
pass_criteria: Actual harness/heatsink/ambient documented; uncertainty included; proposed junction/connector limits met or current derated.

title: Combined loading and regenerative limits
scope: Human performs bounded DC bursts, combined profiles and defined stop/return-energy cases only with an adequate sink/fixture. Model reviews interacting input, switch-node and thermal evidence.
inputs: 7.1 matrix; protection envelope; human-supplied waveforms and signed-current data
deliverables: Combined-load/current/VM traces; duty limits; fault/return-energy results
pass_criteria: No transfer of stepper-only rating to combined use; transients/components inside reviewed limits; actual energy acceptance demonstrated.

title: Derive validated limits and calibration
scope: Fit calibration with uncertainty; determine per-profile ratings and firmware ceilings from measurements; evaluate mixed-load acceptance run and unresolved failures.
inputs: Raw test data; computation scripts; independent requirements and pass criteria
deliverables: Measured rating tables; calibration/error report; firmware-limit changes and retest scope
pass_criteria: No extrapolation beyond evidence; limits trace to raw data; any hardware/firmware change gets affected checks repeated. Stop for user review.

title: Instrument manual and unit records
scope: Assemble user/service documentation from approved pin maps, mechanical drawings, validated rating/calibration tables and actual test records. Do not invent performance claims.
inputs: Only accepted phase outputs; approved documentation outline
deliverables: Operating/service manual; quick start; unit record template
pass_criteria: Every published rating maps to approved evidence; correct hardware/firmware/serial/recovery and thermal/harness requirements.

title: Reproduction and release archive
scope: Package exact CAD, dependencies, BOM/CPL/CAM, firmware/config/calibration schema and test references; verify manifests and reproduction instructions.
inputs: Accepted artifacts; deterministic export/build procedures
deliverables: Release candidate archive; manifest; reproduction checklist
pass_criteria: Artifacts reconcile their frozen revisions; no stale release files or unapproved upload/push; reproducibility checks pass.

title: Final evidence and traceability review
scope: Cross-check manual, firmware settings, hardware source, released manufacturing data and actual qualification evidence; ensure failures/deferred tests remain visible.
inputs: Release candidate; index of underlying evidence; sampled original records
deliverables: Phase-8 final review and release recommendation
pass_criteria: An outside engineer can reproduce/commission/diagnose from the package; all rating claims supported. Stop for user review.
